SALVE ICMBio-MMA Public

Fonte: R/data.R
salve_icmbio.Rd

The Biodiversity Extinction Risk Assessment System - SALVE was developed to facilitate the management of the extinction risk assessment process, coordinated and carried out by ICMBio.

Usage

salve_icmbio

Formato

salve_icmbio_2022

A data frame with 1056 rows and 35 columns:

Reino

Taxonomic kingdom of the species.

Filo

Taxonomic phylum of the species.

Classe

Taxonomic class of the species.

Ordem

Taxonomic order of the species.

Familia

Taxonomic family of the species.

Genero

Taxonomic genus of the species.

Especie

Taxonomic species of the organism.

Subespecie

Taxonomic subspecies of the organism.

Nome_Cientifico_Anterior

Previous scientific name of the species.

Autor

Author of the scientific description of the species.

Nome_Comum

Common name of the species.

Grupo

Biological or taxonomic group of the species.

Mes_Ano_Avaliacao

Month and year of the extinction risk assessment.

Categoria

Extinction risk category of the species.

Possivemente_Extinta

Indicates if the species is possibly extinct.

Criterio

Criteria used for the extinction risk assessment.

Justificativa

Justification for the extinction risk category.

Endemica_Brasil

Indicates if the species is endemic to Brazil.

Consta_em_Lista_Nacional_Oficial

Indicates if the species is listed in an official national list.

Estado

Brazilian states where the species occurs.

Regiao

Brazilian regions where the species occurs.

Bioma

Brazilian biomes associated with the species' occurrence.

Bacia_Hidrografica

Hydrographic basins associated with the species.

Unidade_de_Conservacao_Federal

Federal conservation units where the species is found.

Unidade_de_Conservacao_Estadual

State conservation units where the species is found.

RPPN

Private Natural Heritage Reserves associated with the species.

Migratoria

Indicates if the species is migratory.

Tendencia_Populacional

Population trend of the species.

Ameaca

Known threats to the species.

Uso

Known uses of the species.

Acao_Conservacao

Conservation actions carried out for the species.

Plano_de_Acao

Action plans related to the species.

Listas_e_Convencoes

Lists and international conventions related to the species.

Altitude_min_max_

Altitude range where the species is found.

Barimetria_min_max_

Bathymetry range where the species is found.

...

Fonte

https://salve.icmbio.gov.br/

Detalhes

Data available as in January, 2025.
